21.title: Demo replay - Null login payload
21.rootCause: Checking for credential fields in a null payload raises TypeError.
21.failureLog: Checking for credential fields in a null payload raises TypeError.
21.patchDiff:
diff --git a/api.py b/api.py
index 2961c7f..c55bc82 100644
--- a/api.py
+++ b/api.py
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 from auth import validate_user
 
 def login_endpoint(request_data):
-    if "username" not in request_data or "password" not in request_data:
+    if not isinstance(request_data, dict) or "username" not in request_data or "password" not in request_data:
         return {"status": 400, "message": "Missing credentials"}
     if validate_user(request_data["username"], request_data["password"]):
         return {"status": 200, "message": "Success"}
diff --git a/tests/test_api.py b/tests/test_api.py
index 264b503..3eacb60 100644
--- a/tests/test_api.py
+++ b/tests/test_api.py
@@ -21,3 +21,7 @@ def test_login_unauthorized():
 
 def test_login_missing_fields():
     assert login_endpoint({"username": "admin"}).get("status") == 400
+
+
+def test_null_login_payload():
+    assert login_endpoint(None)["status"] == 400

22.title: Demo replay - Null Authorization header
22.rootCause: Calling startswith on a null header raises AttributeError.
22.failureLog: Calling startswith on a null header raises AttributeError.
22.patchDiff:
diff --git a/middleware.py b/middleware.py
index 0efdbde..6a22f0e 100644
--- a/middleware.py
+++ b/middleware.py
@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@ from auth import validate_user
 
 def auth_middleware(request):
     auth_header = request.get('headers', {}).get('Authorization', '')
-    if not auth_header.startswith('Basic '):
+    if not isinstance(auth_header, str) or not auth_header.startswith('Basic '):
